newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare sees growth shown in earnings.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare sees growth shown in earnings.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Tuesday it expects to see accelerated growth reflected in earnings in the third and fourth quarters of fiscal 1997 ending in February.

"We have turned the corner on our plans to accelerate growth and expect this growth to be increasingly apparent in comparative earnings per share as the next two quarters unfold," chief executive James Usdan said.
The rehabilitation therapy staffing company earlier Tuesday reported second quarter earnings of $1.7 million, or $0.34 a share, compared to $1.4 million, or $0.30 a share a year ago.
